page.overview:
Who is Allure Queen LV7?

Allure Queen LV7 is a character version of the card, "Allure Queen LV7".

Allure Queen LV7 appears in the video game, Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2007. In World Championship 2007, she appears as a Level Six Theme Duelist and she challenges the player to successfully "level-up" 10 or more times and win the duel. By beating her, the player gets closer to unlocking a new Booster Pack.
